issuer: Baja California's Secretaría de Hacienda del Estado (its revenue offices)
note: Read 2026-10-30 in the Congress's copies. The Ley de Ingresos del Estado de Baja California for 2026 (last reform P.O. No. 35, 18 Jun 2026), art. 10, I, gives licences three or five years at the applicant's choice and charges a first automovilista licence $1,095.62 for three years or $1,460.83 for five ($972.49 and $1,296.65 to renew); the three-year term and its fee are held. A licence for a person over sixteen and under eighteen costs $809.10 for up to a year, not held. The Ley que Regula los Servicios de Control Vehicular en el Estado de Baja California (last reform P.O. No. 22, 11 Apr 2025) gives the Secretaría (the Secretaría de Hacienda del Estado) the issuing of licences (art. 4, II), lists automovilista and menor de edad among the licence's kinds (art. 32), asks an automovilista applicant to be at least eighteen (art. 37, II), and gives licences three years from issue (art. 45), which the 2026 tariff widens to three or five.
